title: Pay the new ensemble preprocessing and separate binary heights
statement: Recompute numerical and binary ledgers for the unknown-parameter construction. Fixed rational minima/products/powers/ceilings give polynomial physical variables: translated affine-word counts/force,degree4 stirring with caps polynomial in a,added lowering A ell term at fixeddepth,affine target-reference polynomial impulse envelope,two-stage target synthesis and retained-mode/Bessel/certificate counts. Stable repetitions use n s^5,not total-strain exponentials; completed leaves return I so partial bounds are not multiplied per leaf. Ephys(R) bounds eta^-1,force peak/integral,independent raw target denominators. Separate Ebit(L+R) pays exact input reading/coarsebounds,discarding huge wavevectors by direct comparison before enumeration,coalescing equal modes,tiny coefficient absolute rounding without inversion,controlled root/Bessel/trig precision,identical inverse phases,indexed rational knots,fixed-depth recursion andordinary time-polynomial expansion. Degree<=4. Precomputation runs accepted family/word/saturation tables; constructs rational spatial quadrature and potentially enormous FIXED integer multiplicities; translated-word Taylor/Sobolev bounds;pulse-correction constants;affine/modified-lowering bounds;propagates both ledgers. All finite Fourier/rational/effective estimates,no spectral/norm/PDE oracle. Set p=max(1,degEphys,degEbit),compute nonnegative coefficient sums afterX<=CR,and integer A dominating them plusfixedprecompute/table sizes andcostofcomputingA,p. Then digitalcosts<=A(L+R)^p,physical/tolerancecosts<=AR^p. Known-parameter exponent is not reused without new costs. No practical numerical constants/advantage inferred.
